scope: Derived contracts from complete recovered embedded JavaScript; source is retained only in private research storage. Neither original script was executed. Static evidence does not establish live Steam compatibility.

confirmed_contracts.behavior: argv login/password/shared secret, machine name, comma-separated app IDs and duration in minutes; SteamUser logon
requestFreeLicense before setting online persona and gamesPlayed(appIds, true)
80-second warmup, elapsed-duration and connection checks, clear gamesPlayed and log off at completion

scripts.implementation: Explicit admitted activity IPC, bounded 1-1440 minutes, durable licence-request boundary, renewable lease, cancellation and restart status. Steam activity reporting does not launch a game.

confirmed_contracts.behavior: selected:<path> JSON items, app/context/asset normalization, CS2 versus other-app split
Optional HTTP/SOCKS proxy applies to both SteamUser and Community requests
Optional refresh-token authentication; one password fallback, 10-second WebSocket fallback and additional 20-second connection bound
CS2 trade comment and confirmation acknowledgement workaround
Inventory item conversion, CS2 comment and acknowledgement path also apply in inventory mode

scripts.implementation: Private credential stdin, strict selected-item importer, bounded comments, durable sequential child offers under one batch ID, proxy/refresh-token SDK adapter and one bounded confirmation workaround.
intentional_changes: Never log refresh tokens, proxy URLs, raw SDK errors or secrets.
Do not silently discard malformed selected assets or accept partial integer strings.
Serialize child offers and stop at pending/unknown; do not automatically resume an interrupted batch.
Do not persist or return rotated refresh tokens; caller-owned secret storage integration remains a separate contract.
Do not infer safe resend from missing offer IDs or from unknown free-licence requests.
